description: RTK (Rust Token Killer) PreToolUse hook compresses noisy shell output (pytest/ruff/git/docker/...) before it reaches the agent context. Scoped by an allowlist in .claude/hooks/rtk-bash.sh; skips `uv run` and file reads. Requires `rtk` on PATH; no-ops silently if absent. plan-guard.mjs enforces the owner gates declared in .claude/plan-guard.config.json — the boundary that makes an unattended dispatch loop safe; keep it in sync with the work plan's owner-gate section and test it with `node .claude/hooks/plan-guard.test.mjs`.
